issues.detail: Experian source URL (jobs.experian.com jid-2933) resolves but the vacancy is marked expired. Full JD content is still served and confirms exactly what 'supports: level' claims — explicit 'individual contributor' wording, reports to Senior Manager Global Incident Response, forensics/threat-hunting workstream orchestration, case documentation. Not a dead source, but the citation may rot; consider archiving. Wiz source confirmed (frames the lead as decision-authority management, a tension the profile's notes already disclose honestly).

All three sources resolve and support their claims (IMI JD scopes engineers to build/integrate and excludes policy authorship and awareness curriculum — exactly the basis of the two classificationFlags, both of which name Owner tasks verified present in the packet). IMI career guide places IAM Engineer mid-level but does not explicitly say 'individual contributor' — level support is inferential, consistent with the profile's own hedging.

Red Shield PDF is real and strongly supports level (Reports To: VP Marketing; direct supervision of 1-4 employees including coordinators; agent/producer channel focus; P&C carrier context). However the profile's notes credit the Red Shield JD with validating 'co-op programs' — the PDF never mentions co-op marketing funds. The co-op claim in the description itself is grounded in the packet task 'Allocate And Track Co Op Marketing Fund Usage', so the description is fine; only the notes over-attribute.

Riverwood TPA source supports directing counsel and litigation strategy on litigated files but does not cover budget monitoring/legal-spend control, which its 'supports: description' implies; those claims are grounded in the packet responsibilities ('legal spend control', 'Monitor case plans, counsel performance, budgets'). Salary.com confirms first-level-manager benchmark as claimed. The profile's notes already disclose the source tension accurately.

Both sources resolve and support the two classificationFlags (Indiana WCB explicitly bars NCMs from 'decisions regarding the administration of workers compensation benefits'; both flagged items verified as Owner tasks in the packet). One nit: the profile notes say sources note NCMs 'are usually registered nurses' — the Indiana WCB guideline actually requires a professional degree plus certification (e.g. CCM), not RN specifically.

Federal Reserve URL resolves to the interagency Supervisory Guidance on Model Risk Management, identifier SR-26-2, confirming effective-challenge/independence/organizational-standing language quoted in the profile notes. ValidMind confirms MRM extension to AI tiering and explainability. Fully supported.

Both substitute sources resolve (the profile transparently discloses that WTW/The Actuary 403'd). Umbrex supports exception-rate and deviation monitoring but not appetite tiers or referral/authority thresholds; FinTech Global exists but is conceptual (real-time portfolio visibility, appetite signals) and does not cover hit ratios or pricing-insight feedback that its 'supports: description' implies. Those specifics are grounded in packet Owner tasks, so no ungrounded claims — just weak source-to-claim mapping.

O*NET 13-2053.00 verified: exact quote 'Review individual applications for insurance to evaluate degree of risk involved and determine acceptance of applications' and 'Personal Lines Underwriter' as a listed sample title — this fully supports the classificationFlag proposing Participant->Owner on 'Render Underwriting Decision And Document Rationale' (verified as Participant in the packet). My Next Move confirms IC-level framing (new underwriters work under senior supervision). Clean.

Betterteam source, cited as 'supports: level' for Individual Contributor, actually describes an Incident Manager with team-oversight and upper-management communication duties (mid-to-senior) — weak support for the IC call, though the IC classification itself is defensible from the packet (5 tasks, 4 Participant). Velvet Jobs incident-management-analyst resolves and covers triage/ITSM as claimed.

PA Commonwealth job spec (jobCode 04550) verified: Life and Health Insurance Actuary 1, covering cash values, premium schedules, nonforfeiture soundness, and independent filing approval — exactly as the description claims, and confirming IC level. The classificationFlag item 'Calculate Periodic Income Payment Amount' verified present as an Owner task in the packet. NY DFS page confirms SERFF scope claimed. Clean.

USAA posting on careers.greatersatx.com verified: Property Adjuster Specialist - Field Claims, an experienced IC ('works independently'), explicitly requiring Xactimate, ALE adjustments, and settlement within authority — grounding the description's Xactimate mention, which appears in neither the packet nor O*NET. O*NET 13-1031.00 confirms damage investigation, estimates, and settlement negotiation. Clean.
